steps.body: {"persona": "qa", "prompt": "Draft a failing test (do NOT write it to disk, this is a DRAFT only) for this task: ${taskHint}\n\nThe test must exercise the story's acceptance criteria and currently fail because the behavior doesn't exist yet.
